profile.headline: Hi, I'm Rick.
profile.summary: I'm a product design leader driven by creating systems that give people tools to stop fighting fires so they can do the things they're passionate about.
profile.aboutHeading: A decade-long craft defined with empathy
profile.aboutSummary: Over 13 years, I've worked at the intersection of product design, systems thinking, and implementation—helping teams turn complex workflows into products people can understand and teams can evolve. I'm most useful when the challenge is bigger than a screen: clarifying the problem, finding the right structure, building reusable foundations, and carrying decisions into code. More recently, that includes shaping AI-assisted workflows with the context, review, and human judgment they need to work in practice.

projects.title: Multi Product Integrations
projects.summary: A unified framework for standardizing processes, consolidating data, and integrating workflows across a fragmented ecosystem of products and applications.

previewMedia.alt: Overlapping service interfaces showing work-order records, service listings, inventory, and a map-based activity view.
previewMedia.caption: Selected interface studies for shared service workflows. Screens are modified to protect client intellectual property.

projects.discovery: The work began by identifying core personas and mapping their workflows to create reusable domain experiences that could support future journey and experience maps.
projects.outcomes: Designed a platform framework and collaborated to build trust with early adopters. The effort enabled real-time operational data views, reduced administrative work, and reduced UX-operations rework.
